form.number: Form 02 (revision dated 01/23/2024), 2 pages; also Form 01 organization report, Form 03B surety bond (10/10/2025)
form.notes: Read both pages of the current blank fillable Form 02 (HTTP 200, 256 KB, linked from https://www.minerals.nv.gov/programs/oil-gas/forms-and-reports/; an older 2019 path from a search result returned 404). Page 1: operator and send-to address, lease name, split estate, well no., quarter-quarter, section, township, range (M.D.B.M.), UTM N and E (NAD83), field, county, footages from section lines, distance from nearest town, fee owner (patented land), federal lease serial no., land type (Federal, Private, State), lessee, unconventional stimulation yes/no, proposed depth, elevation and KB, plat if wildcat, bond status and number. Page 2: confidentiality notice (NAC 522.540), certification, office box (Permit No., API No., Approval Date, By), conditions of permit. The form says to submit a proposed drilling program with the application; that program and the Form 01 organization report were not read, so casing, cement, BOP, H2S, water and pit items are unknown.

sources.tested: Found through the NDOM ArcGIS organization search (item modified 2026-05-30). Service ?f=json and layer ?f=json: HTTP 200 (12 KB). One query of all rows without geometry: HTTP 200, 253,108 bytes, 745 rows (max 1,000, not truncated). Status: Plugged 615, In Use 73, Shut-In 45, Abandoned 8, Pending 2, Withdrawn 1, Drilling 1. Well_Type: Prod 707, Inj 15, WW 9, Strat 8. Land_Status: Federal 644, Private 95. Completion years since 2015: 2, 0, 1, 2, 1, 2, 2, 0, 1, 0, 1 (2015 to 2025). Permit numbers run 0002 to 0988. No operator, county or date-approved column.

grade_reason: Free, reachable ArcGIS layer with one row per oil well (permit number, API, status including Pending and Drilling, completion date) but no approval, filing or spud date. Approval dates are only in the titles and PDFs on the Permits page (HTML, six PDFs in six years). Volume is tiny: 2 permits in 2026, none in 2024 or 2025.
producer_plan: For counts of approvals, read the Permits page and parse each link text 'Oil <number> <MM-DD-YYYY> ...' (date format varies: 2-26-2026 and 04-29-2026); that gives approved new-drill permits by month, almost always zero. The page keeps only the current year and five prior years. Use the Oil Well Locations layer (where=1=1, 745 rows, 253 KB) to catch permits not yet on the page (Status Pending, Drilling) and Completion_Date for completions by month; take a snapshot each run and treat a new Permit number as a new permit. Well_Type separates production, injection, water and stratigraphic wells; new drill vs re-entry is not captured. Geothermal and lithium well permits sit on other NDOM pages and are not oil and gas. Expect 0 to 3 permits a year.
privacy_notes: Permit PDFs and Form 02 carry contact names, phone numbers, e-mail addresses and fee-owner names and addresses (not copied). The layer holds no operator or owner names; the permits page names companies only in the cases seen.
